dedupe_keys.name: green infrastructure projects on the university of utah campus

description: Green Infrastructure Projects on the University of Utah Campus is a data set listed in HydroShare, an online repository for hydrology data and models, published or maintained by Youcan Feng (deposited on HydroShare). This dataset consists of.kml and.kmz files identifying locations of green infrastructure projects implemented on the University of Utah campus. The locations are current as of 2013 and may be updated. Coverage: Utah, United States. The resource was created 2016-07-27 and last updated 2017-09-13; HydroShare lists it as a composite resource. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the HydroShare metadata only, so the files and any paper they support were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the abstract may lag the deposit. It can support infrastructure planning, operations and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hydroshare-infrastructure-resources.
